name: AnnualInsurance

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

variations.context: Preparing for an annual insurance payment

setting.background: A large yearly bill is approaching

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing upcoming annual expenses
scenario_template.note: They notice insurance is due in several months

scenario_template.topic: Realizing they have not saved enough for the payment
scenario_template.note: Paying the bill at once could disrupt their monthly budget

scenario_template.topic: Turning an annual expense into monthly savings
scenario_template.note: They ask how much to set aside each month

scenario_template.topic: Creating a sinking fund for annual bills
scenario_template.note: Assistant explains how regular contributions can smooth large payments

scenario_template.topic: Separating annual, monthly, and discretionary expenses
scenario_template.note: They reorganize their budget around different payment schedules

scenario_template.topic: Accounting for other upcoming yearly bills
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests checking taxes, memberships, maintenance, and renewals

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a monthly sinking-fund contribution

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
